steps.title: Do the Giants' Foundry minigame until …
steps.text: Do the Giants' Foundry minigame until level 60. You will need to death storage somewhere.

steps.title: At 60 Smithing, you can do …
steps.text: At 60 Smithing, you can do Blast Furnace without the extra fee, make platebodies until 70 Smithing, or continue doing Giants' Foundry to 70.
steps.note: Smelt gold bars at the Blast Furnace with goldsmith gauntlets (fastest viable); Giants' Foundry is a good XP + profit alternative.
